description: In the final reply, briefly report the verified result in the user's language and offer one relevant optional next step; missing details take priority. Suggestions never perform actions automatically. Saved links let friends join without accounts. Suggest a place the group can vote on (Where tab). Default source=auto searches the same Google Places autocomplete as the web and returns needs_selection with up to five candidates, without a write. A selected google_place_id loads official details and stores the Google Maps link, coordinates and metadata. Zero results use the supplied link or manual name/address. source=manual explicitly saves a link/manual location without lookup. Google lookup failure does not save a fallback automatically. Supplied Google Maps URLs remain available as a zero-results or explicit manual fallback; they do not bypass the default Google lookup. Duplicates are merged. Acts as the participant. Current stored state is available through get_plan. Service use restrictions: plan creation, participation and edits for users known to be under 13 (or a higher local minimum) are prohibited, including under a nickname. Personal data about known underage children, sensitive medical records, intimate content, card details, government IDs, passwords and verification codes are prohibited planning input. This tool covers ordinary non-sensitive group planning only.

google_maps_url.description: Optional Google Maps link (google.com/maps or maps.app.goo.gl). Links with coordinates (…/@50.08,14.42,…) also show a map preview.

google_place_id.description: Exact place ID from returned Google candidates; official details are loaded server-side (max 160 chars).

link.description: Optional link to any other page about the place (http/https), instead of google_maps_url.

name.description: Requested place name, including accents (max 300 chars). A selected Google result supplies its official name.

plan.description: Saved plan link (e.g. https://lesgooo.fun/ab12/when) or its 4-character id. Bare module links such as https://lesgooo.fun/when are local drafts: ask for a saved link, never substitute a previous plan ID.

query.description: Optional Google autocomplete query including the known city/address (max 160 chars); otherwise name/address are used.

source.description: Default auto uses Google first. Manual explicitly saves the supplied name/address/link without a paid lookup.

name: add_place
title: Suggest a place
